derivation.generation: row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY plan_id, role ORDER BY created_at, id) — the D1 §7.2 spine, shared with W-B6
derivation.expiry_event_join: kernel.transition_event.aggregate_id = vision.tickets.id AND payload->>'reason' = 'expiry_detection' (a payload->>'ticket_id' join matches nothing: the payload carries no ticket id)
derivation.closure_reason_effective: coalesce(ticket.closure_reason, 'expiry_detection' when an expiry event exists, 'status:'||status) — computed in this log, never written back to the ticket
derivation.disposition_rules: expired + event → expired_with_event; expired + no event → expired_without_event_waived (waiver_ref required); open/claimed/stale with expires_at < swept_at → open_past_expiry_disposed; everything else → no_disposition_required
derivation.spine_sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        t.plan_id,
        t.role,
        t.id                                             AS ticket_id,
        t.status,
        t.created_at,
        t.expires_at,
        t.closed_at,
        t.closure_reason,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY t.plan_id, t.role
            ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id
        )                                                AS generation,
        count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.plan_id, t.role)    AS generations_total
    FROM vision.tickets t
    WHERE t.plan_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT plan_id, role, generation, generations_total, ticket_id, status,
       (status IN ('open','claimed','stale')) AS is_open_generation,
       (generation = generations_total)       AS is_newest,
       created_at, expires_at, closed_at, closure_reason
FROM ranked
ORDER BY plan_id, role, generation;

deltas_vs_baseline.note: Baselines are the blueprint's 2026-11-17 stamp (R-F12). Rows, plans and the reason census moved with ticket history since then — chiefly this lane's own builder ticket (plan 8261675) and the W-B2 lane's 8261674 ticket. Each delta is reported, never silently absorbed.

waivers.ruling_title: RULING: waive pre-fix terminal gaps; never synthesize historical transition events
waivers.scope: expired generations whose expires_at lies in 2026-06-18..2026-07-26, before the emission fix (PR #560); no row created after the fix is admitted, and no transition event was synthesized
